inherits.meaning: retain the exact six-point pinned seed and add the full universal blocker/support dichotomy

formula.quantifier_order: exists pinned center; forall positive finite shell classes; forall rows; forall outside-seed row points
formula.branch_A: center = canonical blocker AND row support = canonical critical support AND NOT deletion_robust(center)
formula.branch_B: center != canonical blocker AND intersection(row support, canonical critical support) cardinality <= 2

finite_only_assumptions: finite positive-shell inventory at each candidate center
trust_boundary: bounded abstract predicate tests only; no Euclidean realization, arbitrary-cardinality lift, or Lean closure
